name: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
label: Quest
description: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I sense that you have dealt countless fatalities to the Hakkari, friend. You carry the stink of their mojo.
I assume the Shadow talisman has assisted in the culling? Give it to me and allow me to enhance its power.

clips.title: Completion
paras: An assassin of your caliber should be given a wide berth. Your foes must learn respect! You will get just that when the enemy sees the glint of Death's Hand - all too late...
